name: Dagger: Senjou no Saizenten
source:
A young man accidentally wandered into a slave-seller's alley. 
There with vacant eyes sat a young woman, waiting to be sold. 

Unable to look away, he extended his hand to her. 

The tragic story of a lock-hearted girl and an isolated boy.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065904.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个青年意外走进了奴隶贩子的巷子。
那里坐着一位眼神空洞的年轻女子，等待着被卖掉。

他无法移开目光，向她伸出了手。

这是一个关于封闭内心的女孩与孤独男孩的悲伤故事。

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065904.html]DLsite英文页面[/url]）
